Parses a standard urlset sitemap

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.map_urls(engine, url)
puts result.urls.length.inspect
```
